Messages.Author: Tuomas Rinta
Messages.Body:
Let's say Basilia attempts to bleed. Someone blocks her and she plays
Dawn Operation and DotB. In combat she plays Form of Mist, and combat
ends and the opposing vampire is sent to torpor. What if another minion
then gets the required intercept and blocks Basilia, would Dawn
Operation still be in effect, since it says "If bloced, all damage..."
and in this case she is blocked?

Tuomas Rinta

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. Action Modifiers last for the duration of the action by default.
